data.translation: Als die Lampe so sprach und ihr antwortete, wurde es Farchusaf in ihrer Haut zu enge, und sie hatte wohl platzen, ja sterben mögen. -

summary: All secure uses belong to bursting and its figurative emotional/outbreak uses. Detransitive Preterit tiqo/tiqi and Infectum mitoqo describe events without an external core agent; no execution, killing or independent causative meaning is inferred.
29/462 mitaqwo is Infectum-wa with a threatened emotional outcome; 62/217 mitoqo is ordinary Infectum. The new box is justified by form, despite past narrative German.
The MAC Tiqo is a frightened interpretation of donkey noise, not proof that an explosion occurred. Repairing its parsed example preserves that evidential limit.
An explicit Detransitive sense 1 is supplied solely because the parsed entry has Detransitive boxes but no Detransitive sense list; the inherited active sense wording is retained.
Round 2 only. Jan English is a project machine translation; semantic decisions are based on the Turoyo. Round-1 proposals remain prior material and are not re-proposed here.
The recurring emphatic ṭ spellings include unambiguous bomb bursting (3.12/121), supporting provisional filing under tyq without altering any source spelling.
Active firing at people and Detransitive outbreak occur together at 1.41/1812. Do not identify the suppressed agent of Detransitive with the target of the active construction.
Jan 1.24/1240 miṭəqiwo supports the inherited Detransitive Infectum-wa but its machine translation uses active set them off. No quotation is added from that mismatch.
The corpus has interview speech as well as written prose. No new idiomatic phrase is established; ʕal firing belongs in the numbered construction because it alters the verb government.
Verify whether the inherited active Infectum k-tayqi bambayat is genuinely causative or has a different box convention; the present occurrences do not license moving it.
Clarify the source of the malformed 97HD heading during editorial review; the supplied corpus identifies it as MAC Hanna Dewo/96.
At JTM 3.2/2, does feminine tiqo have a recoverable event noun or an impersonal default? Keep outbreak as a contextual extension until confirmed.
Confirm tyq versus a separate ṭqq/ṭyq root in the active firing forms ṭəqulle, ṭəqqe and ṭaqwo. The literal bomb ṭiqo supports the connection but does not settle etymology.
Resolve L-agent number and assimilation in ṭəqulle (1.41/1810–1812) and ṭəqqe tfənge (2.3/337).
Is hedi ṭiqo (1.41/1812) a finite Detransitive or a shooting noun?
Review the English rendering of miṭəqiwo at 1.24/1240 before quoting it.
A gunshot triggers a figurative outbreak “everywhere” in JTM 3.2/2. The violence/event participant is implicit; do not create a sense from the German noun Hölle.
Jan supports the round-1 outbreak extension: explicit u Sayfo, danger ʕal aṣ ṣəroye, locative b Məḏyaḏ and bare warnings ṭiqo. No new Detransitive sense.
Pistol/shotgun spontaneous discharge continues bursting without an external core agent; no technical subsense is required.
